description: manni docs cite/get-started, run in a repo that holds the page's lib/limits.ts, docs/limits.md and manni.config.yaml.

steps.description: Node.js prerequisite: node --version prints a version.
manni cite is available.
Preview the citation: --dry-run prints the frontmatter diff and the report line.

runShell.command: manni cite add docs/limits.md:6-7 lib/limits.ts:2 --id fetch-timeout --dry-run
runShell.stdio: /\+citations:[\s\S]*\+\s+lines: 3-4/

steps.description: Write it: the same report, claim at file lines 16-17.

runShell.command: manni cite add docs/limits.md:6-7 lib/limits.ts:2 --id fetch-timeout
runShell.stdio: docs/limits.md: added fetch-timeout to frontmatter (claim at lines 16-17

steps.description: Check it: both ends current, green summary.

runShell.stdio: /fetch-timeout\s+:16-17 current\s+lib\/limits\.ts:2 current[\s\S]*1 file checked, 1 passed, 0 failed, 0 findings/

steps.description: Commit the page.

runShell.command: git -c user.name=Docs -c user.email=docs@example.com commit -qam "cite the fetch timeout"

steps.description: Someone raises the timeout to 30_000 in a commit.
The commit that raises it.

runShell.command: git -c user.name=Dev -c user.email=dev@example.com commit -qam "raise fetch timeout to 30s"

steps.description: source-changed is an error: names the pin's commit and one commit since, exit 1.

runShell.stdio: /:16-17 current\s+lib\/limits\.ts:2 changed since [0-9a-f]{7}, 1 commit[\s\S]*0 passed, 1 failed, 1 finding/

steps.description: --show-diff prints the commit subject and the diff.

runShell.stdio: /raise fetch timeout to 30s[\s\S]*\+export const FETCH_TIMEOUT_MS = 30_000;/

steps.description: A plain update skips the changed source and exits 1.

runShell.stdio: /fetch-timeout\s+. skipped: changed since [0-9a-f]{7}, 1 commit[\s\S]*0 citations rewritten in 0 files, 1 skipped/

steps.description: Fix the page: the sentence says 30 seconds.
update --accept re-pins both ends and prints the accepted claim text.

runShell.stdio: /claim at line 16 re-pinned \(changed; now "The fetch timeout is 30 seconds\. It is not configurable\."\)[\s\S]*source lib\/limits\.ts:2 re-pinned at [0-9a-f]{7}[\s\S]*2 citations rewritten in 1 file, 0 skipped/

steps.description: The next check is current at both ends.

runShell.stdio: /:16-17 current\s+lib\/limits\.ts:2 current/

steps.description: Someone adds two comment lines at the top of lib/limits.ts.

runShell.command: node -e "const f=require('fs'),p='lib/limits.ts';f.writeFileSync(p,'// Limits enforced by the fetcher.\n// Change with care.\n'+f.readFileSync(p,'utf8'))"

steps.description: source-moved is a warning naming the new line, exit 0.

runShell.stdio: /lib\/limits\.ts:2 moved -> lib\/limits\.ts:4[\s\S]*1 finding \(1 warning\)/

steps.description: update --dry-run shows the one-scalar diff first.

runShell.stdio: /-\s+lines: 2\s+\+\s+lines: 4/

steps.description: update rewrites the range.

runShell.stdio: /fetch-timeout source lib\/limits\.ts:2 -> lib\/limits\.ts:4 \(moved\)[\s\S]*1 citation rewritten in 1 file, 0 skipped/

steps.description: The next check is current at lib/limits.ts:4.

runShell.stdio: lib/limits.ts:4 current

steps.description: Insert a paragraph above the sentence.

runShell.command: node -e "const f=require('fs'),p='docs/limits.md';f.writeFileSync(p,f.readFileSync(p,'utf8').replace('The fetch timeout','Limits apply per run.\n\nThe fetch timeout'))"

steps.description: claim-moved is a notice, exit 0.

runShell.stdio: /:16-17 moved -> :18-19\s+lib\/limits\.ts:4 current[\s\S]*1 finding \(1 notice\)/

steps.description: update rewrites claim.lines.

runShell.stdio: /fetch-timeout claim lines 16-17 -> 18-19 \(moved\)[\s\S]*1 citation rewritten in 1 file, 0 skipped/

steps.description: Edit the sentence.
claim-changed is a warning, exit 0.

runShell.stdio: /:18-19 changed[\s\S]*1 finding \(1 warning\)/

steps.description: Read the new text with --show-diff.

runShell.stdio: /:18-19 changed[\s\S]*not configurable per request\./

steps.description: Accept it, scoped with --only.

runShell.stdio: /claim at line 18 re-pinned \(changed; now "The fetch timeout is 30 seconds\. It is not configurable per request\."\)[\s\S]*1 citation rewritten in 1 file, 0 skipped/

steps.description: Anchor with a marker: --marker writes the marker and pins what it anchors.

runShell.command: manni cite add docs/limits.md:21 lib/limits.ts:5 --id retries --marker
runShell.stdio: added retries to frontmatter; marker at line 29, claim pinned at line 30

steps.description: The marker sits above the sentence in the body.

runShell.stdio: /<!-- cite retries -->\r?\nRetries default to 3\./

steps.description: Add the fenced block the page shows, after the retries sentence.
Pin the code block with --quote.

runShell.command: manni cite add docs/limits.md:32-36 lib/limits.ts:3-5 --quote --id limits-block
runShell.stdio: added limits-block to frontmatter (claim lines 42-46, a block that reproduces lib/limits.ts:3-5)

steps.description: All three citations show up in one green check.

runShell.stdio: /fetch-timeout\s+:36-37 current\s+lib\/limits\.ts:4 current[\s\S]*retries\s+marker :39 current\s+lib\/limits\.ts:5 current[\s\S]*limits-block\s+:42-46 current\s+lib\/limits\.ts:3-5 current[\s\S]*1 file checked, 1 passed, 0 failed, 0 findings/
